formats.name: post_update_offer_event
formats.notes: Links only via action button (book, order, learn more, call now); posts older than 6 months archived unless date range set; Offer needs title+dates+times; Event needs title+start/end; hotels cannot post offers; phone numbers in text may be rejected

formats.name: photo
formats.notes: JPG or PNG, 10 KB to 5 MB, minimum 250x250 px; shows only after verification; ratio 1:1 is a practitioner convention, official page gives 720x720 recommended

formats.name: video
formats.notes: Up to 30 seconds, up to 75 MB, 720p or higher; shows only after verification

post title max chars for offer and event posts
hashtag and mention support in posts

chat/messages removal date (secondary source only; BUSINESS_CONVERSATIONS marked deprecated officially)
API-side scheduled publish time for posts
